semiconductor_relevance: High — TDC Corporation specializes in ultra-precise polishing and mirror-finishing technologies that are critical for semiconductor substrate preparation and manufacturing.
summary: TDC Corporation provides advanced polishing services and technologies for semiconductor substrates, focusing on achieving nano-level surface roughness and high precision. Their capabilities include contract polishing for diamond wafers and large-area substrate processing, essential for high-performance semiconductor applications.
